import pandas as pd

# Load intermediate_step1: grouped average reading_score by school_name
intermediate_step1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_40/intermediate_step1.csv"
df_avg_reading = pd.read_csv(intermediate_step1_path)

# Load Source1 (school info)
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_40/training_1.csv"
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Join intermediate_step1 with Source1 on school_name
df_joined = pd.merge(df_avg_reading, df_source1[['school_name']], on='school_name', how='inner')

# Select only the columns required by the target schema
Target2_40 = df_joined[['school_name', 'reading_score']].copy()

# Ensure reading_score is float type
Target2_40['reading_score'] = Target2_40['reading_score'].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
Target2_40.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the first numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_40_0 and Source2_40_1 on school_name (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="school_name", how="inner")

# Group by school_name and aggregate average reading_score
result = joined.groupby("school_name", as_index=False).agg({"reading_score": "mean"})

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_40/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
